name: obsidian-writing-mode
description: A quiet, distraction-free writing mode, with optional typewriter scroll and dimming. Choose from a range of papers, or use your own theme. Designed to work on desktop and mobile.

scripts.install:vault: npm run build && mkdir -p "${SP_VAULT:?Set SP_VAULT to your vault folder}/.obsidian/plugins/writing-mode" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$SP_VAULT/.obsidian/plugins/writing-mode/"

author: Beth Dean
